start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:give-paid-buyers-access." Every time it runs (every 15 minutes is the intended schedule), turn each newly paid Stripe checkout into a customer: list the checkouts completed since the last one kept, skip any already kept, check each paid amount against a price the offer declares (a trial checkout is checked by its subscription's amount), keep a customer record keyed by the checkout, send the setup email once with an idempotency key, and mark each customer whose subscription ended as ended, keeping their record.

3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is mark-ended.
